title: Dynamic Pricing Regulation for Public Shared Autonomous Vehicle Services: computational record
description:
Frozen computational record supporting the manuscript “Dynamic Pricing Regulation for Public Shared Autonomous Vehicle Services”, prepared for submission to Transportation Research Part B: Methodological.

The record contains the simulator and constrained PPO source code, training and validation scripts, static-fare, checkpoint-selection, headline and common-target evaluation workflows, selected policy checkpoints, frozen candidate and scenario manifests, seed-level result archives, recorded computational environments, and SHA-256 provenance over every file.

The three processed runtime input files required for re-execution are identified by SHA-256 hash in the provenance directory and in Table EC12 of the electronic companion. The data-availability statement in the repository README identifies the public research-data record containing them.
